title: Pengendalian Lalu Lintas Secara Elektronik (ERP/PL2SE)
legal_status: draft; not an enacted operating regulation

events.description: Entered the legislative programme but was not discussed; the exact programme date should be verified from the legislative record.
The draft was revised and resubmitted for discussion with the DPRD; legal basis, tariff, road, and vehicle provisions remained to be settled.
DKI described a traffic-management draft covering ERP, progressive parking, and stronger low-emission zones.

title: Expansion of Jakarta Low Emission Zones
legal_status: pilot and roadmap; wider implementation status requires current JDIH verification

events.description: Kota Tua was designated as Jakarta's initial low-emission area.
Jakarta and Breathe Cities launched an integrated low-emission-zone roadmap covering transport and additional sectors.

title: Vehicle emission-test enforcement measures
legal_status: existing testing obligation; additional enforcement mechanisms under preparation

events.description: Pergub DKI No. 66 of 2020 established motor-vehicle emissions-testing rules.
DLH described electronic ticketing, highest parking disincentives, and pollution-based vehicle taxation as measures being prepared to improve compliance.
